svg.aria-label: The same five-layer pipeline written for macOS and for Windows. Capture, see, act and verify each need a platform-specific implementation: on macOS, the system speech recogniser or a local whisper build, the accessibility tree and Vision text recognition, AppleScript and synthetic input events; on Windows, a local whisper build, UI Automation and the built-in OCR, and Windows input and window activation. The decide layer in the middle is one HTTP call to the same model with the same request on both platforms, and is highlighted to show it is the only row you do not write twice. The caption notes that this is why the port is mostly mechanical and why the interesting design work sits in what you put on the candidate list.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

svg.text: ONE OF THESE FIVE LAYERS IS NOT PLATFORM WORK

svg.text: Four rows are a port. The middle row is the same code on both machines.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: So the design work is not the decision. It is what you are willing to put on the candidate list.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Write the see and act layers behind one interface and the port stops being a rewrite.
